# HoDoKu TypeScript engine

This directory contains a vendored copy of `gil/HoDoKu-ts` pinned to commit
`e5b01c91b9dca647a5cf276d69f311a1517c7fcb` (retrieved 2026-10-12).

HoDoKu-ts is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later and derives from HoDoKu,
copyright © 2008–2012 Bernhard Hobiger. The upstream licence is preserved in
`COPYING`; the upstream README is preserved as `README.upstream.md`.

STrack adds only local build metadata and consumes the engine through the
public API. Generated JavaScript and declarations in `dist/` correspond to the
preferred TypeScript source in `src/`.
